name: vulopilot/how-stepper
title: How It Works Stepper (VuloPilot)
description: Auto-playing step-by-step section (Find, Understand, Prioritize, Fix, Verify). Edit every step: icon, title, text, points and the graphic or image on the right.

intro.default: Every problem goes from found to fixed, and proven.

default.title: Find
default.desc: One scan looks at your whole website.
default.points:
Pages, plugins, speed, search, content and AI visibility
Runs from your WordPress dashboard
Re-run any time, or on a schedule

default.title: Understand
default.desc: See the exact page with the problem, what is wrong, and why it matters.
default.points:
The exact page and element
A plain-language explanation
Severity, so you can judge the impact

default.title: Prioritize
default.desc: Know what to fix first and what can wait.
default.points:
Ranked from critical to low
Quick wins surfaced first
Skip what can safely wait

default.title: Fix
default.desc: One click, an AI draft you approve, or a clear note for your developer.
default.points:
One-click AI fix
Preview before and after, then approve
Or send a note to your developer

default.title: Verify
default.desc: See the result for yourself, with proof it worked.
default.points:
Scan again after the fix
Scores and history show the change
Undo any applied change
